title: Publish memories via shareable public link (frontend)

requirements.summary: Add authenticated UI to enable/disable publishing and copy a shareable public link for the user’s memories.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is authenticated, the UI provides controls to: (1) enable publishing, (2) disable publishing, and (3) copy the current share link to clipboard.
The UI clearly indicates the current publishing status (published/unpublished).
If publishing is enabled, the UI shows the share link in a copyable form (button or input + copy).
If the user is not authenticated, publish controls are not shown and/or an access-required message is displayed.

file_operations.description: Update frontend backend type definitions to include the new publishing/share-link backend capabilities required by the UI (e.g., read publish status + current share token, enable/disable publishing, regenerate token).

Create React Query hooks for authenticated publishing management (fetch publish status/share token; enable/disable; regenerate token; handle authorization errors). Use the authorization component patterns for authenticated-only data access. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an authenticated-only UI card to manage publishing status and copying the share link (includes status indicator, enable/disable action, optional regenerate action, and a copy-to-clipboard control). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Button, Input) and sonner toasts for success/error feedback. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new PublishShareCard into the authenticated memories area (only visible when the user is authenticated), ensuring all user-facing text is English and publish controls are not shown to unauthenticated visitors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a public shared-memories mode that detects a share token in the URL and renders a read-only gallery without requiring sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: When the app loads with a share identifier/token present in the URL (query or hash), the app renders a public read-only gallery view for the shared memories instead of the private authenticated experience.
The public view uses the backend public-share query API to fetch and display the published memories (image + caption/date where available).
The public view does not show upload, edit, or other authenticated-only controls.
If the share link is invalid or the owner has unpublished, the public view shows a clear empty/error state in English (e.g., “This shared page is unavailable”).

file_operations.description: Extend frontend backend type definitions to include the public-share read capabilities needed for unauthenticated viewing (e.g., list published memories by share token and optionally fetch a single published memory), aligned with the updated backend actor.

Create public-mode React Query hooks to fetch shared published memories using the share token (no Internet Identity required). Use blob-storage ExternalBlob direct URLs for image rendering. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a public, read-only shared memories page that reads the share token from the URL (query or hash via existing urlParams helpers), fetches shared published memories, and renders a gallery + detail view without any upload/edit controls. Include English empty/error states such as “This shared page is unavailable”. Use shadcn-ui for layout/feedback components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a read-only gallery component tailored to public memory types (e.g., uses MemoryPublic id field) that renders images via ExternalBlob.getDirectURL and opens a read-only detail dialog. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a read-only detail dialog for public memories (caption/date/upload time where available) without any publish/edit actions. Use shadcn-ui Dialog components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add startup detection for a share identifier/token in the URL (query or hash) and conditionally render SharedMemoriesPage instead of the private Valentine experience when present. Ensure the public mode does not rely on Internet Identity sign-in to view data. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
